entities.name: Tawny
entities.description: Stonework puma, an artifact creature ally from Zendikar and the only survivor of a run-in with a Bala Ged yellow ooze.

entities.name: Everflowing Chalice
entities.description: Prized item Tawny carried back in its mouth.

entities.name: Bala Ged

events.summary: Tawny is the only survivor of a disastrous run-in with a yellow ooze and returns to base camp carrying the Everflowing Chalice.
